text:
Elena: Heads up — we have a customer SQ call tomorrow 10am PT. They specifically asked for: RBAC delta since last onboarding, audit log retention + export proof, KMS envelope flow and HSM attestations, vuln triage timeline and incident response runbook. Can folks confirm who can own each artifact?

Mohit: I can own the KMS envelope flow diagram and HSM attestation notes. Will pull attestation certs from the vendor folder.

Jamie: I can take audit logs and retention. Today retention is 365 days for admin/audit_events, 90 days for request-traces. Customer asked for signed export proof — we have the export job, but not a canned signed manifest.

Ingrid: I can provide the RBAC delta since onboarding (role diffs + list of service accounts changed). Need a concise table for the call.

Ben: I’ll grab the vuln triage timeline + recent IR playbook updates. Also can sketch the short sequence diagram of escalation (oncall -> sec-eng -> legal) they requested.

Elena: Thanks — can we get one consolidated artifact bundle (PDF) to share in the call? Preferably with: RBAC diff CSV, audit-export sample + manifest, KMS envelope diagram, attestation cert references, vuln triage timeline, IR runbook link.

Mohit: Quick note on KMS: our envelope flow uses external-key-wrapping in the private deployment; sample envelope JSON looks like:

```json
{"ciphertext": "<base64>", "wrapped_key": "<base64>", "kms_key_id": "projects/…/locations/…/keyRings/…/cryptoKeys/…"}
```

Mohit: The HSM attestation we reference is from vendor "VaultHSM Corp" and we store the certs in the secure artifacts bucket under `s3://redwood-enterprise/attestations/vaulthsm/`. I’ll include the object paths.

Jamie: For the audit export proof, suggested approach: run the export job to a temp bucket, compute SHA256 of the exported tar, and sign it with our signing key (customer asked for non-repudiable proof). I can run a demo now and attach the signed manifest.

sre-oncall: FYI we have a recent query to hit the logging pipeline if you want sample entries: `resource.type="redwood_server" AND protoPayload.methodName="CreateSession"`. Retention policy is enforced by lifecycle policy — legal asked about deletions: we keep immutable snapshots for 30 days before lifecycle can delete (for legal holds we can extend).

Ingrid: RBAC diff: I’ll generate `rbac-delta-2026-03-25.csv` with columns (principal, previous_roles, current_roles, modified_by, modified_at). Any objections to share that raw CSV in the bundle?

Ben: Fine to share CSV but redact SSO user emails (use hashed IDs). Also remove internal service account tokens. I’ll run a quick scrub script.

Elena: Actions and owners: Mohit -> KMS envelope diagram + attestation paths (deliver by EOD). Jamie -> audit export + signed manifest (deliver in 2 hrs). Ingrid -> RBAC delta CSV (deliver 1.5 hrs). Ben -> vuln triage + IR deck + scrubbed CSV (deliver by call). Sre-oncall -> paste example log entries into the bundle.

sec-bot: Reminder: security-review checklist requires an artifacts index and >=2 reviewers before external share.

Mohit: Will ask for reviewer from infra and sec-eng once I upload.

Jamie: Started export job now — ETA ~30m. Will post manifest and SHA256 once done.

Ingrid: Generating CSV, will pseudonymize emails with `sha1(email)` and add mapping file for internal use only.

Ben: Drafting the IR quick-runbook (1-page) and the escalation flowchart. Also adding a short note on SLA for patching and typical triage MTTR.

Elena: Great — after artifacts are uploaded, please ping me here with links. I’ll assemble the PDF bundle and upload to the secure share for the call. Also bring the signed manifest and one example audit entry to read aloud during the call.

Jamie: Export done. Uploaded to `s3://sec-exports/temp/5543219876/audit-export.tar.gz` and manifest `audit-export-5543219876.json` with SHA256 `b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184`. Will sign and post signature file in 10m.

Mohit: Uploaded KMS diagram `kms-envelope-v1.pdf` and attestation objects list at `s3://redwood-enterprise/attestations/vaulthsm/2026-03-24/`. Filed for review.

Ben: Uploaded `ir-quick-runbook.pdf` and scrubbed `rbac-delta-5543219876-scrubbed.csv` to `s3://sec-artifacts/calls/5543219876/`. Added notes about what was redacted.

sre-oncall: Pasted 3 sanitized log entries into `s3://sec-artifacts/calls/5543219876/log-samples.txt` (removed IPs and user ids).

Elena: Perfect. Who can review the bundle quickly? Need 2 reviewers before we share externally.

Jamie: I can review Mohit’s attestation paths and Ben’s scrubbing notes.

Mohit: I’ll review the RBAC CSV for service-account noise.

sec-bot: Review checklist: [x] artifacts uploaded, [ ] 2 reviews, [ ] bundle assembled, [ ] external share permission.

Elena: Tagging @Ingrid and @Jamie — please add your review approvals as comments in the artifacts folder. I’ll assemble once approvals are in.

Ingrid: Added short review note and LGTM.

Jamie: LGTM on attestation and manifest signature.

sec-bot: Review checklist updated: [x] artifacts uploaded, [x] 2 reviews, [ ] bundle assembled, [ ] external share permission.

Elena: Thanks everyone — I’ll upload the final PDF to the secure share and post the link in this channel before the call. If anything blocks, ping me immediately.

Ben: One quick follow-up for the call — customer asked about timeline for adding FIPS-certified HSM options. I’ll add an FAQ slide and a proposed roadmap note.

Mohit: Noted — will include vendor compatibility notes in the KMS doc.

Elena: Closing thread for prep. Will reopen if any last-minute items pop up. Good work.
